roles.title: Investment Professional, Generalist - Soft Catalyst & Fundamental Long/Short
highlights: Primary investor responsible for managing the only long short fundamental equity portfolio at Meridian Capital Partners

Lead investment decisions for the portfolio including sizing of positions based on conviction level/idiosyncratic volatility, hedging of positions using public peers and/or appropriate sector ETFs/market indices, and timing of position initiation and monetization

Generate new investment ideas based on detailed and disciplined diligence processes, including meetings with C-Suite Executives/IR, calls with third-party experts, attending industry conferences, and analyses of alternative datasets provided by third parties

Provide portfolio updates on a bi-weekly basis to Meridian's Founder/CIO and CRO including formal quarterly updates/presentations on position level performances, hit rates, and key risk metrics such as target volatility and factor attribution

roles.title: Investment Analyst, Consumer & TMT - North53 Capital
highlights: Principal analyst responsible for managing the Consumer and Technology portfolio within the $4.2bn gross portfolio for Vertex Capital

Co-managed the risk exposures of the Consumer and Technology portfolio with the Senior Portfolio Manager including discretion over position sizing (idiosyncratic volatility/conviction), alpha/factor exposures (hedges), and timing of position entry/exit

Presented new investment ideas based on fundamental analyses, primary research, industry events/conferences, sector expert consultations, and company management meetings; actively present findings/ideas through written memos and deep dive analyses

Constructed and maintained financial models for core positions, with analyses evaluating growth drivers, competitive positioning, and structural/strategic transformation; includes operating model, DCF, comparable companies, LBO, and precedent transactions

roles.title: Associate - Private Equity

Performed due diligence on businesses to determine competitive advantages, key growth drivers, addressable markets, and risks
Worked directly with management at portfolio companies to manage any operational and liquidity risk, particularly during COVID
Board observer: Strategic Safety Solutions (global industrial consulting firm), MedTech Manufacturing (medical device contract manufacturer)

roles.title: Analyst - Healthcare Investment Banking

Exclusive financial advisor - BioPharm Corp's $8.5bn acquisition of Oncology Therapeutics Inc
Exclusive financial advisor and lead-left arranger of financing - Blackstone Life Sciences' acquisition of Clinical Research Partners
